question: 'The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn' is a book written by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mark Twain.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

__
 
• In February 1885, Mark Twain has published **“The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn”.**
 
• **Samuel Langhorne Clemens** is known by his pen name Mark Twain, as an American writer, humorist, entrepreneur, publisher, and lecturer.
 
• He was lauded as the "greatest humorist the United States has produced," and William Faulkner called him **"the father of American literature". **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Ruskin Bond** has been conferred the Tata Literature Live! Lifetime Achievement Award for 2020.

 
 
• He has a substantial body of work, close to 100 books, across genres for children and adults.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shri in 1999 and Padma Bhushan in 2014.
 
 
 
• **Alice's Adventure in Wonderland** is a book by** Lewis Carroll.**
 
• **Joseph Rudyard Kipling** was a British journalist, short story writer, poet, and novelist. He was born in India.
 
 
• He received the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1907 and his poems and stories were very popular in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
